verdict.rationale: Sketch documents its .sketch file format as a zipped archive of JSON and binary data (sketch-docs-23/47), and community evidence confirms this enables a plugin ecosystem and git-style tooling outside the vendor app (sketch-comm-14). However, this is not a formally published open spec/standard with versioned schema docs, and there's no independent tooling ecosystem comparable to open formats like SVG; the developer-handoff features are more about inspection than format portability. Missing for 10: a formal published format specification/schema documentation, third-party tools that read/write .sketch independent of Sketch's own SDK, and any standards-body or open-format commitment.
